info.title: worker-protocol — actions
info.description: Performing an operation a Worker accepts. The `configure` reading address of ACT-15 is not described here: its address is declared inside an Action rather than beside the Capability, and the document it answers is shaped by that Action's own input schema, which is the Worker's.

servers.description: ACT-1. The address the `actions` entry declares, resolved per DESC-12.

address.description: Read from the Worker's Descriptor and resolved per DESC-12. Never assembled by a caller (ENDP-1). The default is `/` and not a host on purpose: a client that was never given an address should fail at its own origin rather than reach somebody else's.

post.description: ACT-5. The body is the input and carries nothing else, so a console posts its form result verbatim and a Worker validates it against the schema it published with no envelope to unwrap.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: ACT-5. One of the Actions the entry declares. Naming none is `400`; naming one it does not declare is `404`.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: ENDP-15. Where the Action declares it reads a key from the header. Within the declared window a repeat under the same key is not a second performance; the same key with a different body is `409`.

parameters.name: Worker-Protocol-Capability-Version
parameters.description: ENDP-6. The Capability version the caller expects. A Worker that cannot answer it refuses the request whole with `400` and `unsupported_version`, and never substitutes its own.

requestBody.description: ACT-2. The Action's own input, against the JSON Schema its entry declares. This protocol has no data model, so no shape is fixed here.

200.description: ACT-10. The Action completed and declares a result, against its own declared schema.

Worker-Protocol-Edition.description: ENDP-5. The edition that produced this answer. A caller that sees one it did not expect re-reads the Descriptor rather than parsing the body.

Worker-Protocol-Capability-Version.description: ENDP-5. The Capability version that produced this answer.
